---
title: "Yun-Tse Tsai/Ûn-te̍k Chhòa/蔡昀澤"
---

Staff scientist, Fundamental Physics Directorate, SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory

Experimental physicist with extensive experience in hadron colliders and in neutrino experiments
based on the liquid-argon time-projection chamber (LArTPC). Led the project of a LArTPC R&D
setup at SLAC, the commissioning of the data acquisition (DAQ) system of the MicroBooNE
experiment, physics analyses in astroparticle and exotic physics in MicroBooNE and DUNE, and
measurement of electroweak top quark production cross section at DØ.

More details can be found in my
